note: Median single-transaction latency of POST /score, 200 requests after warm-up, laptop (Ryzen CPU), Docker Desktop on Windows.
finding: The ~44 ms difference is Docker Desktop's Windows-to-Linux-VM port forwarding for request bodies (same client code: 7.8 ms inside the container, 51.9 ms from Windows; GET /health without a body takes 1.5 ms). Limiting XGBoost to 1 or 4 threads changed nothing.
